features.title: Platform Foundation and Environments
features.user_visible_behavior: A developer can open ProjectBrain locally, see a healthy API response, and see a clear unavailable state when MongoDB or a required provider configuration is missing.
verification: Run `./init.sh`.
Install dependencies using the repository-documented command.
Run the frontend and API build, lint, type-check, and test commands.
Start the local stack and verify the frontend and API health endpoints.
Withhold a required configuration value and verify a safe readiness failure.
Confirm secrets are not committed and model-provider keys are not exposed to browser code.

features.title: Memory Collections and Search Indexes
features.user_visible_behavior: Project memory for one project can be stored and retrieved as messages, decisions, attempts, entities, edges, warnings, feedback, and harness versions. Search results from another project do not appear.
verification: Apply the collection and index definitions to the development database.
Insert one attempt, one decision, and one edge, then read them back by project id.
Run the dead-end vector search shape against a fixture embedding and confirm the project and outcome filters.
Confirm a second project id is excluded from those results.
Confirm pipeline checkpoints are stored in MongoDB and not in a worker-local file.

features.title: Capture and Extraction Pipeline
features.user_visible_behavior: A captured Slack-style or web message becomes a structured decision or attempt. A later result in the same thread updates that attempt instead of creating a duplicate.
verification: Run unit tests for classification labels and the extraction schema.
Post a manual capture that starts an attempt and a later result in the same thread, and verify one attempt with outcome, blockers, and evidence.
Verify noise messages are stored but do not create attempts or decisions.
Verify embeddings are written on attempts and decisions.
Verify each pipeline node emits a trace.

features.title: Dead-End Check
features.user_visible_behavior: Pasting a plan that repeats a failed approach returns the matching dead end, the blocker, the evidence, the alternative, the hours previously spent, and a confidence score. A genuinely different idea does not warn.
verification: Run the retrieval and judge unit tests, including tricky non-matches.
POST /api/check with a WebSockets-on-serverless idea and verify a match above the cutoff, with blockers and hours spent.
POST /api/check with an unrelated idea and verify no warning.
Verify the judge can reject a high vector score when conditions differ.
Verify results never include another project's attempts.

features.title: Orbit Seed and Eval Set
features.user_visible_behavior: The Orbit project shows six weeks of history, including four dead ends, a superseded authentication chain, and a later decision that can reopen the WebSockets dead end. The eval set contains the cases used to measure recall.
verification: Run the seed script against an empty development database so messages pass through the capture pipeline.
Confirm four attempts with the specified outcomes, hours, and alternatives.
Confirm the sessions, JWT, and Better Auth chain is stored as superseded decisions.
Confirm the eval set contains 40 cases: 15 dead-end, 15 decision-recall, and 10 condition-met, including 5 tricky non-matches.
Confirm seeded attempts are produced by extraction rather than inserted as finished records.

features.title: Slack Capture and Proactive Warnings
features.user_visible_behavior: When someone says they are about to repeat a failed approach in Slack, ProjectBrain replies in that thread with the past dead end, evidence, alternative, and estimated hours saved.
verification: Run Slack event signature and intent-classification tests.
Replay the socket.io intent fixture and verify a threaded warning with confidence, blocker, alternative, and hours.
Verify a non-matching message does not post a warning.
Record the warning in the warnings collection.
Verify a not-relevant action is stored as feedback.

features.title: Cited Answers
features.user_visible_behavior: Asking why the team rejected an approach returns a concise answer that cites the attempt or decision. A superseded decision is not presented as the current one.
verification: Ask the Postgres search question against seeded Orbit data and verify the benchmark citation and the Atlas Search alternative.
Ask what authentication the team uses and verify Better Auth is current and JWT is marked superseded.
Verify an unsupported question does not invent a dead end.
Verify citations resolve to attempt and decision ids in the same project.
Post feedback on an answer and read it back.

features.title: Revisitable Conditions
features.user_visible_behavior: When a new decision satisfies a dead end's conditions, ProjectBrain says that dead end may now be possible and marks it revisitable instead of leaving it as an active failure.
verification: Capture the App Runner decision through the pipeline.
Verify the WebSockets attempt status becomes revisitable and the explanation names the serverless blocker.
Verify an unrelated decision does not flip other dead ends.
Verify the link between the new decision and the attempt is stored.
Replay the decision event and verify a single transition.

features.title: Timeline and Dead-End Detail
features.user_visible_behavior: The Orbit timeline shows decisions and attempts over six weeks. Failed attempts are red, revisitable ones are amber, and opening a dead end shows the goal, approach, blockers, evidence, conditions, hours, and what the team did instead.
verification: Run frontend lint, type-check, and route tests.
Load the seeded Orbit project and verify four dead ends and the superseded authentication decisions appear in order.
Open the WebSockets dead end and verify evidence, 14 hours, conditions, and the SSE alternative.
After the condition re-check, verify that node is amber.
Exercise the timeline and detail flow in a browser.

features.title: Ask the Brain and Check an Idea
features.user_visible_behavior: A person can ask a project question and see cited attempt and decision cards, or paste a plan and see similar dead ends with match confidence.
verification: Ask the seeded Postgres question in the browser and open a citation.
Paste the socket.io plan into Check an Idea and verify the WebSockets dead end, confidence, and hours.
Paste a non-matching plan and verify an explicit no-match state.
Verify loading and failure states.
Exercise both screens in the browser.

features.title: Self-Improving Harness
features.user_visible_behavior: Running reflection proposes one harness change, re-runs the eval set, and keeps the new version only when the score improves without a precision drop. Rejected proposals stay recorded with the reason.
verification: Run the eval runner on the 40 cases and record precision, recall, citation accuracy, and staleness.
Force a candidate that lowers precision and verify it is not promoted.
Run a candidate that improves the parent score and verify it becomes the active harness version.
Verify extraction and matching read prompts and thresholds from the active harness config.
Verify feedback and failed cases are inputs to the proposal.

features.title: Harness Lab and Impact
features.user_visible_behavior: Harness Lab shows version history, score changes, and the diff of what reflection changed. Impact shows warnings sent, hours saved from accepted warnings, and the precision trend.
verification: Open Harness Lab and verify at least two versions with scores and a diff.
Run reflection from the button and verify the timeline updates only after promotion.
Open Impact and verify hours saved equals the sum of hours spent for accepted warnings.
Record a not-relevant feedback action and verify it is visible to the reflection inputs.
Exercise both screens in a browser.

features.title: Memory Graph
features.user_visible_behavior: A graph shows decisions, attempts, and entities connected by caused-by, superseded-by, alternative-to, blocked-by, and unblocks edges.
verification: Render the Orbit graph and verify the WebSockets attempt links to the SSE decision.
Verify the authentication decisions show the superseded chain.
Verify selecting a node opens its record.
Verify the unblocks edge appears after the condition re-check.
Exercise the graph in a browser.

features.title: Workers, Nightly Reflection, and Evidence Storage
features.user_visible_behavior: Evidence files can be opened from a dead-end record. A scheduled reflection run can promote a harness version without someone clicking the button.
verification: Upload a fixture log to object storage and verify the attempt evidence URL resolves.
Run the worker entrypoint that processes a capture job outside the web request.
Invoke the reflection job the way the schedule would and verify it uses the same promotion rules.
Validate the AWS infrastructure definition without deploying production resources.
Verify a failed scheduled run does not promote a harness version.
